title: Record Linux x86_64 Step 1 evidence: native gate, build/startup timings and the measured inner delivery loop
goal: On a Linux x86_64 host, run the native local gate on the current integration head, measure cold and warm debug builds, isolated startup and health, and a genuine source change that reaches the rebuilt live executable. Record failures with root causes and do not claim any Windows-only Step 1 item.

criteria: the evidence file names the source commit, lock digest, toolchain, host and every command with its measured result
every gate failure carries a root cause, and nothing not executed (cargo-deny, local-build, check-inference, Windows items) is claimed
task records moved to done/ are only those whose acceptance command executed nonzero passing tests on the combined tree
